title: 第15章 虎哥第16章 拳法
content_zh:
此刻，张逸风在思考今后修炼的问题，前几日他在别墅炼药，一共熬制出药丸八颗，八颗药丸全部吃完，就能让他的修为提升到淬体二层。
但由于没有丹炉，也没有寻到火源，这些药丸杂质太多，他不能一次性服用，只能每天服用一颗，算上今日，他一共服用了三颗，也就是说还要五天，他才能将修为提升到淬体二层。
张逸风不是纠结五天时间太慢，而是五天后，当修为提升到第二层，他要如何将修为提升到第三层？提升到第二层之后，就算再炼制相同的药丸，也没有多大的作用了。除非找到更好的药材，但想要找到药材，一是需要运气，二是需要钱。
“今晚去珍宝园看看吧，不知道能不能有收获。”
张逸风着急提升修为，是因为他知道实力的重要，地球虽然没有修炼者，但地球有强大的兵器，比如手枪，俗话说武功再高也怕菜刀，张逸风现在的修为，遇到手持手枪的人，肯定要完蛋。估计要进入淬体七、八层，才能硬抗手枪。
另外，张逸风还不确定，地球到底有没有修炼者，因为崋夏国一直有古武和气功的传说。甚至，国外还有异能者。
张逸风经历得多，他觉得或许这些传说不是空穴来风。或许几千年前，地球的灵气还不是这样稀薄，那样的话，的确能诞生一些修炼者。

同一时间，学校门口，五位牛高马大的大约三十左右的男子从一辆国产uv车上下来了。
这五人身穿背心，短裤，肩膀上都纹着五花八门的纹身，有的是蛇，有的是虎，有的是英文字母。
这五人直是站在那里，就透着一股强大的气场，他们的肱二头肌比一些男人的拳头还要大。
“快看，于超的打手！”
“又来了，难道张逸风回学校了？”
“的确回了，听说张逸风又把于超打住院了。”
“有种，但这下死定了。”

同学们暗自议论，纷纷远离，这些都是社会人士，他们惹不起。
“虎哥，你终于到了。”
五人一下车，于超留在学校的根班立马跑了过来，朝着左胳膊纹着老虎的人走了过去。这个人应该就是虎哥了。
虎哥身高一米九，眼神平淡地看了跟班一眼，瓮声瓮气地道：“你是于超身边的小华吧？路上耽搁了一下，来得晚了点，事情于超都给我说了，说起来你们三个真是丢人，三个人连一个都打不过。”

小华有些尴尬，道：“虎哥，你不知道，那个张逸风不知道吃了什么药，像是忽然练过了。”
“行了，废话少说，我们忙得很，那个落败少爷现在在哪里。”
“在经济系教学楼，正在上课。虎哥，我们是在校门口等他出来，还是去学校？”
“等？万一他不出来呢，当然是去学校。”
“可那里终究是学校里啊，要是事情闹大了。”小华担忧的声音传来，他怕将自己牵连进去，学生在学校里打架和社会混混来学校打人并且将人打成残废的性质是不一样的，学校肯定会追究。
虎哥不屑一笑道：“能有多大？放心，不会牵扯到你，大不了虎哥我再去牢房里待两天，正好清静清静。”
像虎哥这样的人，牢房对他们来说，就是旅馆，一年总会去几次。象征性的关几天，就出来了。只要没有杀人，事情没有真的闹大，就没有什么事情是钱摆不平的。
肖冰能在经开区混的风生水起，自然也有一些关系。
“那就好。虎哥，那我们进去吧。”
小华领着虎哥正要进入学校，虎哥的手机忽然响了。
content_en:
At this moment, Zhang Yifeng was thinking about his future cultivation issues. He was refining medicine in the villa a few days ago and brewed a total of eight pills. After eating all eight pills, his cultivation level would be upgraded to the second level of Body Tempering.
However, since there was no pill furnace and no source of fire found, these pills had too many impurities. He could not take them all at once. He could only take one pill a day. Counting today, he took a total of three pills, which meant that it would take five days before he could reach the second level of body tempering.
Zhang Yifeng is not worried that five days is too slow, but after five days, when his cultivation reaches the second level, how will he improve his cultivation to the third level? After being promoted to the second level, even if you refine the same pill again, it won't have much effect. Unless better medicinal materials are found, but if you want to find medicinal materials, you need luck and money.
"Let's go to the treasure garden tonight and have a look. I don't know if I can gain anything."
Zhang Yifeng is anxious to improve his cultivation because he knows the importance of strength. Although there are no cultivators on Earth, it has powerful weapons, such as pistols. As the saying goes, no matter how high your martial arts skills are, you are still afraid of kitchen knives. With Zhang Yifeng's current cultivation level, if he encounters someone holding a pistol, he will definitely die. It is estimated that you need to enter the seventh or eighth level of the tempered body to resist the pistol.
In addition, Zhang Yifeng is not sure whether there are practitioners on earth, because there have always been legends of ancient martial arts and qigong in the Weixia Kingdom. There are even people with super powers abroad.
Zhang Yifeng has experienced a lot, and he feels that maybe these legends are not groundless. Perhaps thousands of years ago, the spiritual energy of the earth was not so thin. In that case, some cultivators could indeed be born.

These five people were wearing vests and shorts, and they all had various tattoos on their shoulders, some were snakes, some were tigers, and some were English letters.
These five people just stood there, exuding a strong aura, and their biceps were bigger than some men's fists.
"Look, Yu Chao's thugs!"
"Here we go again, is Zhang Yifeng back to school?"
"I did come back. I heard that Zhang Yifeng beat Yu Chao and hospitalized him again."
"Yes, but now I'm dead."

"We are in class at the Economics Department teaching building. Brother Hu, should we wait for him to come out at the school gate, or should we go to school?"
"Wait? What if he doesn't come out? Of course he will go to school."

The nature of students fighting in school is different from that of social gangsters coming to school to beat people and beat them to disability. The school will definitely pursue the case.
Brother Hu smiled disdainfully and said: "How big can it be? Don't worry, it won't involve you. At worst, Brother Hu, I'll stay in the cell for two more days, just in time for peace and quiet."
For people like Brother Hu, the cell is like a hotel, and they always go there several times a year. After a few days of symbolic detention, he was released. As long as no one is killed and things don't get really big, then there's no problemNothing can be settled with money.
Xiao Bing's success in the Economic Development Zone naturally has something to do with it.
